705580101.text: Instructor, what do you think of the design of this survey route?

705580102.text: The height here... and the obstacles... You've managed to preserve real-world conditions without compromising the difficulty of the challenge... And you've even managed to retain a degree of fun. Very well done.

705580103.text: Mr. Tres, I don't think I have much more to teach you. The next step is to consolidate what you've learned and apply it to new scenarios...

705580105.text: What else are you worried about?

705580106.text: If I could learn as fast as you can, the gunsmiths of the 8th Coy... especially Koch, would parade me around as the poster child for hard work, then use me to guilt-trip those lazybones!

705580107.text: You're already doing very well, Elowen...

705580108.text: Didn't you make the calibration objects we used this time? If it had been my job, uh... they probably would have ended up in Vice Captain Lohen's display case of unidentified objects...

705580111.text: There are so many people gathered here... Are the Knights of Favonius having a picnic?

705580112.text: Ah, it's the Honorary Knight and Paimon! Greetings!

705580113.text: This is Mr. Tres. Vice Captain Lohen sent him here to compare notes and learn some cartography skills with me, so together we designed the "Surveying and Searching" challenge...

705580114.text: And this is Elowen. A member of the Reconnaissance Company, just like me. She's helped us a lot these past few days.

705580115.text: #Oh, it's the renowned Honorary Knight and {M#his}{F#her} companion Paimon! I've heard so much about you, but seeing you in person is something else entirely. You have a truly commanding presence.

705580116.text: Wait... What!? My goodness, it's actually them... What do I do, what do I do...? Think, Elowen, think...

705580117.text: Huh? N-No need to get so nervous...

705580118.text: Hmm... Don't worry, Elowen just slips into certain "states" sometimes... Right now, she should be in... a "state of utmost reverence"?

705580119.text: Projecting a complex persona... Thereby making it more difficult for others to pin you down... Yes, that's right... Another trick for the toolkit...

705580120.text: ...Tres, I think you're thinking way too much. I'm just a rookie, and the world's best knight is standing right in front of me! Isn't it normal to be nervous?

705580121.text: Besides, this is the perfect time to ask for an autograph... W—Wait, how should I go about asking for that...
